resources.string: "Everything you've borrowed here: requests, staff handouts and self-checkouts. No membership is needed to see it."
"Read the space's current waiver. Accepting it is recorded against your membership."
"Accept the space's current waiver before borrowing, booking or checking in."
"This space has no waiver to accept."
"I have read and accept this waiver"
"The waiver changed while you were reading. Review the current version below."
"This needs an active membership of this space. Join or renew from your member area, or ask space staff if you think your membership should be active."
"Your membership of this space is not active. Ask space staff to review it."
"Your membership term has ended. Renew your membership from your member area, then try again."
"Accept the space's current waiver in your member area, then try again."
"Check in at the space first (in your member area or at the front desk), then try again."
"Your account is restricted at this space. Talk to space staff to resolve it."
"A space manager has not given you access to this machine yet. Ask space staff to give you access, then try again."
"Your access to this machine has ended. Ask space staff to renew it, then try again."
"This item is lent only through an event. Ask the event organizers to request it for you."
"You can't renew loans yourself here. Ask space staff to renew it."
"This loan has reached its renewal limit. Return it, or ask space staff."
"Loan renewals are switched off in this space. Ask space staff."
"Online machine requests aren't available here. Ask space staff for help."
"This event is open to members of its participating organizations. Ask your organization to confirm your membership, or contact the organizers."
"Staff must review this event's audience before registration opens. Try again later or contact the organizers."
"This event isn't taking organization registrations right now. Contact the organizers."
"This event's audience changed. Reload it to check whether you can still register."
"Ask for the equipment you need for one of your events or bookings: pick a kit the space published, or choose items one by one."
"You have no upcoming event registrations or bookings here. Register or book first, then ask for equipment."
"Browse the inventory first to choose items one by one."
"This request was already received. Track it in Activity."
"Your consumables are reserved for this event or booking."
"The space is busy with another request. Try again in a moment."
"This request changed since you first sent it. Check it and send it again."
"Subscribe your phone calendar to your events and shifts here. The app never keeps the feed link."
"Anyone with this link can see these entries"
"The feed link works without signing in. Only add it to your own calendar. Making a new link stops the old one working."
"Your feed is ready. Add it to your calendar now: the link is shown only once."
"No calendar app could open the feed. Make a new link from a device with a calendar app."
"Add Google as another way to sign in to this account. Confirm it's you first."
"Enter your password (and authenticator code, if you use one)."
"That didn't match. Check your password or code."
"Your confirmation expired. Confirm it's you again, then link."
"This account has no password, so it can't be confirmed here. Link providers from the member area on the web."
"Google is linked. You can now sign in with it."
"Google sign-in isn't available on this device."
